blocking_finding.summary: Phase3 accepts repaired_B384 and REF384_repeat saved outputs that are not bound to the supplied pair COMPLETE.
blocking_finding.cause: The receipt validator checks only generic finalization fields and hashes of the two supplied JSON files. It neither requires COMPLETE.execution_states nor links each repaired/repeat curated_output to the completed arm path/hash.
blocking_finding.risk: A valid or synthetic pair receipt from an unrelated run can authorize scoring arbitrary saved repaired/repeat outputs, breaking run attribution.

required_repair: require exact repaired_B384 and REF384_repeat execution_states in pair COMPLETE
verify each execution-state complete_path exists, is non-symlink, and matches complete_sha256
bind each request curated_output to the exact completed arm namespace and expected sorter-output location
reject missing, swapped, unrelated, or hash-mismatched execution states in managed-entry tests
preserve all estimators, thresholds, cohort, schema, amplitude ancestry, and missing-evidence semantics
